sample_unit: questions (each entered at three education-level prompts across three models)

links.outcome: Readability of AI cardiovascular answers relative to requested education level and average literacy
links.effect: Readability decreased significantly with increasing education level across all models (p<0.001); output complexity often exceeds average literacy. ChatGPT Free more readable than MediSearch (p<0.001).
links.quote: These findings indicate that while NLP models adjust readability by education level, output complexity often exceeds average literacy, highlighting the need for refinement to optimize AI-driven patient education.

unlisted_practices: Prompting LLMs to tailor responses to a stated education level to adjust readability

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and response similarity of LLM-generated CVD education across prompts reflecting different user education levels, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
